data.rationale: The proposal gets the IMDb → Rotten Tomatoes → mail-compose sequence and the film and day parameters right, but it wrongly ends with Send instead of Discard (the true workflow says never to send), and it models the friend as a separate recipient_email and recipient_name instead of one {friend} that fills both @example.com and the greeting. That error is unsafe to automate, and the Rotten Tomatoes step and the mail "New message" step are vague.
